title: Supply and Demand
summary: Prices settle where the quantity supplied equals the quantity demanded.

key_concepts.explanation: The price at which supply equals demand.
How strongly demand responds to a change in price.

outline.heading: The demand curve
points: Demand falls as the price rises.
Income and tastes shift the whole curve.

outline.heading: Market equilibrium
points: A shortage pushes the price up.
A surplus pushes the price down.

questions: What happens to the equilibrium when demand and supply both rise?
